name: Sudden Fear
body:
School necromancy [emotion, fear, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 1, bard 1, bloodrager 1, cleric/oracle 1, death mage 1, inquisitor 1, lathspell 1, legendary ninja 1, psychic 1, shaman 1, sorcerer/wizard 1, white necromancer 1, witch 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one living creature with 5 or fewer HD
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Will partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

On a failed saving throw, the target becomes frightened for 1 round. On a success, they are instead shaken for 1 round.
